Usage: zhihu search [OPTIONS] QUERY

  Search Zhihu content.

Options:
  -t, --type [general|people|topic]
                                  Search scope
  -l, --limit INTEGER             Max results  [default: 10]
  -a, --answers INTEGER           Answers per question (0=hide)  [default: 3]
  --json                          Output raw JSON
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
